name: Korlinda
description: The site of the Peace Summit at which the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.

description_citations.text: "Qadir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an empire.
timeline.quote: the Qadir first calls the Fallaji an "empire"

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra attend the summit and meet for the first time since leaving Tocasia's camp.
timeline.quote: The brothers saw each other for the first time at the summit since they had left Tocasia's camp.

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Warlord and Qadir fail to agree on the Sword Marches and a fight breaks out; the Warlord orders the ornithopters to bomb the dragon engine.
timeline.quote: The Warlord ordered the ornithopters to bomb the dragon engine

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Qadir stabs the Warlord to death in retaliation.
timeline.quote: the Qadir assassinated the Warlord in a quick fit of rage

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's avenger chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it; Urza's Mightstone and Mishra's Weakstone overload it and it explodes.
timeline.quote: The opposite forces overloaded the Avenger, making it explode.

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Peace Summit at Korlinda fails because both countries claim the Sword Marches; the Warlord dies there.
timeline.quote: which failed spectacularly because both countries claimed the Sword Marches as their own
